title: 大稻埕實景導覽照片
description:
Red Brick Arcade and Parked Scooters

A two‑story red brick arcade building stands along Dihua Street in Taipei’s Datong District, showcasing a row of elegant arches on the ground floor and large, multi‑pane windows above. The façade features decorative stone panels and traditional Chinese characters reading “豐濱,” hinting at the building’s historical or commercial significance. 

In front of the arcade, a neat line of motor scooters occupies the street parking spaces, reflecting the daily rhythm of urban commuters. The contrast between the vintage brick architecture and the modern scooters captures the blend of heritage and contemporary life in Taipei. The bright daylight illuminates the scene, emphasizing the textures of the brickwork and the vibrant colors of the parked vehicles.
